questions.question: What does the Sahara pump theory explain?
options: How flora and fauna left Africa to penetrate Eurasia and beyond
How the Sahara desert was formed
How the Nile River was blocked by the Sudd
How African pluvial periods created larger lakes
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states the Sahara pump theory explains how flora and fauna left Africa to penetrate Eurasia and beyond.
Incorrect. The formation of the Sahara is not what the Sahara pump theory explains according to the article.
Incorrect. The blockage of the Nile by the Sudd is a separate fact, not the Sahara pump theory.
Incorrect. African pluvial periods are associated with the Wet Sahara phase, not the Sahara pump theory.
